$description: The colour roles of the docs site and its landing page. Jekyll builds the site and cannot run the generator, so the generator writes their values into docs/. They reach no output of Krönika.

docs.$description: The docs site, tumult.rs. It is light only, so the generator writes the light theme, except for the terminal.

scheme.$description: The colour variables of the docs theme, just-the-docs, by their names there. The generator writes them to docs/_sass/color_schemes/_tumult-tokens.scss. Each text colour is 4.5:1 or more on the page and on the code panel.

body-background-color.$description: The page: white, as a panel is. Krönika has a grey page and white panels; the docs have a white page and grey panels.

sidebar-color.$description: The sidebar: the grey of the light page.

border-color.$description: Thin lines: tables, code panels and pictures.

feedback-color.$description: The fill of a sidebar link under the pointer and of the chosen search result.

nav-child-link-color.$description: The links of the lower levels of the sidebar.

search-result-preview-color.$description: The preview text of a search result.

link-color.$description: Links: 5.3:1 on white and 4.9:1 on the sidebar.

grey-dk-000.$description: The dim grey of the theme: the numbers of lists, the sidebar footer and the search. The value of the theme is 3.0:1 on white; dim text passes.

tumult-code-comment.$description: Comments and prompts in code: 8.8:1 on the code panel.

tumult-code-keyword.$description: Keywords in code: the fail red, darker, so that it is 5.5:1 on the code panel.

tumult-code-string.$description: Strings in code: the ok green, darker, so that it is 5.3:1 on the code panel. The ok green is 4.0:1 there.

tumult-code-number.$description: Numbers and constants in code: the warn amber, darker, so that it is 5.3:1 on the code panel.

tumult-code-name.$description: Names in code: 4.9:1 on the code panel.

landing.$description: The landing page, docs/index.html. The generator writes them to docs/assets/css/tokens.css as custom properties of the same name.

page.$description: The page: white, as the page of the docs is.

band.$description: The grey bands across the page, and the install box.

border.$description: Thin lines: the edges of the cards.

border-strong.$description: The edge of the second button.

text.$description: Body text and headings: 15.9:1 on white.

text-dim.$description: Text that matters less: 9.5:1 on white and 8.8:1 on a band.

copper.$description: The copper of the logo, darker for text: 5.8:1 on white and 5.3:1 on a band.

copper-hover.$description: The primary button under the pointer.

copper-bright.$description: The copper of the logo. It is 3.5:1 on white, so it draws arrows, marks and edges only.

on-copper.$description: Text on the primary button: white.

terminal.$description: The GameDay terminal of the landing page. It is dark on purpose, as the terminal player above it is, so the generator writes the dark theme. Each is a custom property named term- and its name.

border.$description: The edges and the line under the title bar.

command.$description: A command: white, brighter than its output.

dot-red.$description: The first window button of the title bar.

dot-yellow.$description: The second window button of the title bar.

dot-green.$description: The third window button of the title bar.
